subject: Commercial packet and quick priority check — 15m to walk numbers?

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Commercial packet and quick priority check — 15m to walk numbers?

Hi Sophie —

Thanks for taking the time today. As promised, I’m sending over the commercial packet that summarizes the pricing, suggested configuration, and our recommended rollout cadence based on what you shared about the pilot goals. Key highlights below: 

- Proposed capacity: 2 dedicated instances for initial pilot (100k tokens/day)
- Estimated blended unit cost with prefix caching & quantization: ~$0.0028/token
- Recommended pilot length: 6 weeks with automated quality checks at week 2 and week 5

Attachment: Redwood_Commercial_Packet_BrightLane_20280411.pdf (PDF, ~1.2MB)

Next steps I suggested on the call:
1) Confirm receipt of the packet
2) Quick 15-minute walk-through to answer any questions on assumptions (especially around capacity and SLOs)
3) Internal procurement intro if you’re ready to proceed on timelines

Can you confirm you received the packet and whether a short walk-through would be useful? I’m available tomorrow 9:30–11:00 PT and Friday 10:00–12:00 PT; happy to send calendar invites.

If procurement prefers a separate thread, I’ve cc’d a general procurement alias for BrightLane so they have the packet.

Thanks —
Karthik

Karthik Iyer

Perfect — thanks for the note, Sophie. 17:00 PT today works for me; I’ll send a calendar invite for 17:00–17:20 PT and include a short agenda (pricing assumptions, pilot spend cap option, and next steps for procurement).

Short answers to your questions ahead of the call: 
- Blended unit cost: assumes steady-state usage at the pilot configuration with an allowances for short autoscale bursts; I’ll show two scenarios on the call (steady vs burst).
- Pilot spend cap: yes — we can set an explicit monthly cap and configure alerts + automatic throttling if we approach it. We can also add a hard cap if you prefer, and I’ll note the operational trade-offs on the call.

I’ve looped in Monica (SE) to be on the call for technical questions. Invite and meeting materials are here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cExamplePacketLink

Looking forward to it.

Karthik
